chapters.reason: The paper frames optimizing test-time compute as a meta-RL problem, improving efficiency without direct length rewards, aligning with the 'without Length Reward' category's focus on implicit budget awareness and meta-reinforcement learning.

The work investigates scaling compute dynamically during inference via sequential revision (viewing output as episodes) and balancing search depth, fitting the 'Efficient Test-time Scaling and Infinity Thinking' category's focus on on-the-fly compute allocation.

While the primary method avoids explicit length rewards, the paper discusses balancing exploration/exploitation in the token stream, which relates to trajectory-level budget considerations, though it is not the core approach.
